Regulatory stability under the new government, including clearer export quotas and royalty frameworks, reduces policy risk and supports long-term capex in energy infrastructure and mining logistics.
sectors.ai: Buy selective exposure to coal and nickel names with strong cash flows, as Indonesia's domestic demand and export volumes remain resilient despite global softness. NICE, ALKA, and BIPI lead on volume and margin expansion; rotate into DEWA and BRMS for upside on smelter and downstream processing catalysts. Trim US-linked names, hold through Q3 earnings for dividend surprises.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Structural shift toward premiumization and digital-native brands (e.g., ZONE, ENZO) is accelerating, as younger demographics prioritize lifestyle and convenience over traditional staples.
sectors.ai: Buy selective momentum names (BIKE, CBUT, POLU) on strong domestic demand and Ramadan tailwinds, but trim exposure to US-linked FMCG as global weakness persists. Watch for profit-taking after outsized gains; rotate into mid-cap staples with earnings visibility. Maintain WATCH signal, adding on dips toward support levels.

Trim TRUMP meme exposure, add SOL ecosystem plays for 2-4 week horizon.
